text: Step 0 says the 0.20 bar must be reachable at held n 15-22 using `bar-reachable.py --mode rate`. That mode only checks that the Wilson lower bound of a perfect n/n score is at least the threshold, so a 0.20 threshold is REACHABLE at any n of 6 or more. The gate can never close the bead UNDERPOWERED. The bar is a 0.20 shift between paired arms, not a rate, and the bead's own history comment says ~0.20 at n=22 is noise level.
